title: Skin Cancer Screening
definition: Full-body exams find melanomas and basal cells early — when cure is a simple excision. Annual screening for high-risk patients. The eye, trained, saves lives.
patient_flow: Patients arrive for rashes, lesions, or screenings; full-body skin exams map every spot. Dermoscopy distinguishes benign from suspicious; biopsies go to dermatopathology. Medical dermatology manages chronic conditions longitudinally; surgical days handle Mohs and excisions with same-day pathology. Cosmetic services run in dedicated suites.
code_demo:
def abcde_check(asymmetry, border, color, diameter_mm, evolving):
    """ABCDE melanoma screen: count suspicious features."""
    flags = [asymmetry, border, color, diameter_mm > 6, evolving]
    n = sum(flags)
    return f"{n}/5 suspicious features -> {'BIOPSY PROMPTLY' if n >= 2 else 'monitor with photos, recheck'}"
print(abcde_check(True, True, False, 8, True))
teaching: Simple: the core idea in plain words — what it is and why it matters.
